landingBlocks.title: Website & service catalog
landingBlocks.body: A fast, mobile-friendly website with your services, service areas, gallery and reviews. You edit everything yourself.

landingBlocks.title: Online booking & dispatch
landingBlocks.body: Customers book open slots online. Assign technicians, manage work orders and follow visits as they happen.

landingBlocks.title: Maintenance plans
landingBlocks.body: Sell monthly or yearly memberships with automatic billing and promo codes.

landingBlocks.title: Online store & invoicing
landingBlocks.body: Sell parts and products online, take card payments and send invoices.

landingBlocks.title: Your own mobile app
landingBlocks.body: An iOS and Android app with your name on it, so customers can book and pay from their phone.

landingBlocks.title: Leads & messages
landingBlocks.body: Contact form requests, customer messages and newsletter signups in one place.

landingBlocks.title: Customer equipment
landingBlocks.body: Keep a record of each customer's units for faster, better-prepared visits.

landingBlocks.title: Referral program
landingBlocks.body: Reward customers who send you new business with account credit.

landingBlocks.title: Choose your plan
landingBlocks.body: Pick a bundle or only the modules you need. You see the full monthly price upfront.

landingBlocks.title: Set up your business
landingBlocks.body: Add your services, prices, service areas and branding from the admin panel.

landingBlocks.title: Connect payments
landingBlocks.body: Connect your own Stripe account so customer payments go straight to you.

landingBlocks.title: Go live
landingBlocks.body: Share your site with customers and start taking bookings.

landingBlocks.title: Do I need a website already?
landingBlocks.body: No. A ready-made website is included. You fill in your services and branding from the admin panel.

landingBlocks.title: Can I change my modules later?
landingBlocks.body: Yes. Modules can be added or removed after you sign up, and your price changes with them.

landingBlocks.title: How do customer payments work?
landingBlocks.body: Payments run through your own Stripe account. Card details are handled by Stripe and the money goes to you.

landingBlocks.title: Does it work on phones?
landingBlocks.body: Yes. Your website works on any device, and the Branded Mobile App module adds your own iOS and Android app.

landingBlocks.title: What does Priority Support & Custom Development include?
landingBlocks.body: Priority support plus up to one hour of small customizations each month. Larger custom work is quoted separately.

aboutUs.title: Comfort XPro
aboutUs.description:
Comfort XPro is a flexible business platform built for modern service and contracting companies.

We bring together the tools businesses need to manage their daily operations, teams, customers, services, products, and online presence in one connected system.

From the office to the field and from your website to your customer's mobile device, Comfort XPro helps keep your business connected.

Built Around Your Business

Every business is different.

That is why Comfort XPro is designed to be flexible. Our multi-tenant platform can be customized to support different industries, workflows, services, and business models.

Comfort XPro can support businesses such as:

  • HVAC
  • Plumbing
  • Remodeling
  • Electrical
  • Kitchen and Bath
  • General Contracting
  • Pest Control
  • Pool and Spa
  • Lawn Care and Landscaping
  • Cleaning
  • Roofing
  • Appliance Repair
  • Garage Door
  • Water Treatment
  • Solar and Generators
  • Restoration
  • Handyman
  • Carpet Cleaning
  • Window Cleaning
  • Pressure Washing
  • Painting
  • Flooring
  • Fencing
  • Locksmith
  • Chimney
  • Septic
  • Home Services
  • Other service-based businesses

Each business can have its own branded experience, customized features, users, workflows, and content while operating on one powerful platform.

One Platform. Different Experiences.

Comfort XPro is designed for the people who keep your business moving.

For Business Owners and Administrators

Manage your business from one place.

Monitor customers, employees, technicians, jobs, products, services, orders, payments, and business activity through an organized and easy-to-use management system.

Get the visibility you need without jumping between multiple disconnected platforms.

For Technicians and Field Teams

Give your team the information they need wherever the job takes them.

Technicians can access assigned jobs, customer details, service history, equipment information, estimates, invoices, and important job updates through a mobile-friendly experience built for work in the field.
